reason: The cited lines describe a read-only web search tool returning ranked results, snippets, developer/research/PDF/GitHub results, and optionally extracted page content from searched pages. They do not show arbitrary host code execution. They describe open-web/public sources rather than host files, databases, credentialed SaaS, localhost, or intranet data, so SECRET is not supported. They explicitly characterize the operation as query-only/read-only and not modifying external sites; sending a query to a fixed search service is not a SINK under the label definition, and no agent-chosen exfiltration destination is shown. Because results/content come from arbitrary web domains and sources, the returned content is attacker-controllable, so UNTRUSTED is supported.
